parsed.rationale: Both `NowPlayingItem` (in `AppServices`, `Shared/AppServices/Sources/AppServices/NowPlayingService.swift:23`) and `PlaycutSelection` (in `app:iOS`, `WXYC/iOS/Views/Playlist/PlaylistView.swift:23`) are `type-alias-object` structs with an identical two-field shape — `playcut:Playcut` shared verbatim and `artwork` differing only in image type (`Image?` vs `UIImage?`). The sole structural difference is the platform-specific image type, making this a textbook candidate for a single generic struct parameterised on the artwork type. The generic type could live in `AppServices` (or a lower-level shared package both already depend on), with `NowPlayingItem` and `PlaycutSelection` becoming typealiases `PlaycutItem<Image>` and `PlaycutItem<UIImage>` respectively, or dropped entirely.
